cases.name: link
cases.when: `href` is set -- the whole card is a real <a href>, whatever `interactive` says
cases.reason: There is no link pattern to bind, and that is not an omission: a link's role, its keyboard activation and its focusability all come from the platform the moment the element is an <a href>. Binding `button` here would name a role this element does not have, and rebuilding the anchor's affordances on a div would lose exactly what href exists for -- open in a new tab, copy the address, hear it announced as a link. The same shape, and the same reason, as SideNavItem's own link case.

cases.name: surface
cases.when: `interactive` is false -- the default, and nothing obliges a consumer to change it
cases.reason: arena-card renders a bordered surface with an optional eyebrow/title header and an `action` slot; it manages no state, adds no role, and owns no interactive element of its own -- any button or control inside comes from the content slot or from `[action]`, both caller-supplied, not from Card itself. This is the shape that keeps a dead tab stop off every card of every list.

cases.name: interactive
cases.when: `interactive` is true -- the whole card is one activation target, the ordinary shape of a list on a phone
